description: This file defines an abstract base class for HTTP services in a Java project, handling server setup, routing, endpoints, tracing, security, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: HttpServiceBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for HTTP services, including server setup, routing, endpoint management, tracing, security, and lifecycle handling.

methods.name: addEndpoints
methods.description: Adds multiple endpoint configurations to the service.

methods.name: addEndpoint
methods.description: Adds a single endpoint configuration to the service.

methods.name: setAuthHandler
methods.description: Sets the authentication handler for securing routes.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the service configuration, injecting dependencies.

methods.name: getPortDefaultValue
methods.description: Provides the default secure port, override for service-specific default.

methods.name: getInsecurePortDefaultValue
methods.description: Provides the default insecure port, override for service-specific default.

methods.name: getActualPort
methods.description: Returns the actual port the secure server is listening on.

methods.name: getActualInsecurePort
methods.description: Returns the actual port the insecure server is listening on.

methods.name: preStartServers
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to perform initialization before starting servers.

methods.name: startInternal
methods.description: Main startup sequence: pre-start, check ports, start endpoints, bind servers, and post-start.

methods.name: onStartupSuccess
methods.description: Callback after successful server startup.

methods.name: createRouter
methods.description: Creates and initializes a Vert.x Router with tracing, error handling, body size limiting, and auth.

methods.name: createTracingHandler
methods.description: Creates a tracing handler with custom tags for request tracing.

methods.name: addAuthHandler
methods.description: Adds authentication handler to router if configured.

methods.name: addEndpointRoutes
methods.description: Registers routes for all configured endpoints.

methods.name: addCustomRoutes
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to add custom routes.

methods.name: getHttpServerOptions
methods.description: Configures options for secure HTTP server creation.

methods.name: getInsecureHttpServerOptions
methods.description: Configures options for insecure HTTP server.

methods.name: bindSecureHttpServer
methods.description: Binds secure HTTP server to specified port if enabled.

methods.name: bindInsecureHttpServer
methods.description: Binds insecure HTTP server to specified port if enabled.

methods.name: startEndpoints
methods.description: Starts all registered endpoints and adds their routes to the router.

methods.name: stopEndpoints
methods.description: Stops all endpoints.

methods.name: stopServer
methods.description: Stops the secure HTTP server if running.

methods.name: stopInsecureServer
methods.description: Stops the insecure HTTP server if running.

methods.name: preShutdown
methods.description: Hook before shutdown; can be overridden.

methods.name: postShutdown
methods.description: Hook after shutdown; can be overridden.

methods.name: registerReadinessChecks
methods.description: Registers readiness checks for all endpoints.

methods.name: registerLivenessChecks
methods.description: Registers liveness checks for all endpoints.
